review_scope: Read-only plan review using integer workload arithmetic and existing receipts. No model/reference/test/query execution or new pilot.
verdict: qualified_planning_only_counts_correct_no_execution_release; clarify mandatory replay and 1200s scope, then freeze concrete query/output strategy before the one pilot

query_counts.volume_duplicate_policy: Both identical base/temporal 80x80 passes are counted independently, as required by no-dedup policy.
query_counts.boundary_condition: Correct if frozen replacement schedules contain exactly 501/501/1001 distinct nodes. Recompute from actual arrays/hashes; do not silently union extra near-coincident output times.
query_counts.scope: 27279360 covers two equivalent no-dedup inference passes only. Training/validation derivatives, the earlier pilot and non-inference work are additional.

material_findings.issue: Mandatory extracted fresh-forward/operator replay is not explicitly included in the 1200s new-full projection.
material_findings.resolution: Include a second 13639680-state pass, checkpoint loading, query/reduction/export I/O and integrity comparison if all raw scientific outputs are reproduced. The measured one-pass pilot cost can be a labelled replay proxy, not a bound. No cached neural-output replay.

material_findings.issue: candidate_new_full_budget_s=1200 has no explicit inclusion/exclusion equation or overrun interpretation.
material_findings.resolution: Declare whether 1200 is a prelaunch feasibility decision budget or an actual runtime cap. At minimum project 10000 complete update cycles, step-zero validation/setup, original reload/query/output and mandatory extracted pass. List final error/mass/parity/region/operator analysis, readbacks, startup, figures, snapshot/archive/extraction and replay-comparison costs separately when unmeasured. Excluded work cannot support complete-study-under-1200 wording. Mean/median/max 25-step extrapolations are not guaranteed bounds. If a hard cap is intended, preserve interrupted/failed status and checkpoint rather than claiming 10000 completed updates.

material_findings.issue: Batch size, reduction/serialization precision/schema and membership-check algorithm remain deferred, so memory/output cost is not concrete yet.
material_findings.resolution: Freeze deterministic positive batch size, lazy ordered query generation, inference/no-gradient mode, accumulator/output dtypes, area-mean reduction/flush, volume/edge field schemas and compression/file schedule. Memory should scale with a chunk plus reduced outputs. Avoid materializing a 10.56-million-entry Python tuple union solely for membership checks: tensor-product x/y/time node-axis membership per Gauss rule and execution representation can implement the same intersections. Include chosen freeze/membership work in setup timing/RSS.

storage_arithmetic_not_measurement.illustrative_compact_schema: Both three-field Gauss-mean arrays, h-only volume probes, signed-normal-q-only edge probes. This is an example, not a selected schema or compressed-size prediction.
storage_arithmetic_not_measurement.limits: Bare payload excludes axes/weights, metadata/provenance, checkpoints/optimizer/history, temporary buffers, figures and archive duplicates. Individual Gauss point states need not persist; reduced scientific arrays must persist for replay.

pilot_timing_requirements: Inclusive outer wall plus separate setup/init/partition-membership/hash costs. There are 25 Adam updates but 26 validations/history states including step zero.

Objective/coordinate derivatives, backward/all-parameter gradients, Adam, validation/selection, history and latest/selected checkpoint persistence need non-overlapping timers and actual write counts. Pilot selection-write frequency need not match full fitting.

Time trusted reload, deterministic coordinate generation/conversion, both Gauss rules, all three volume/edge schedules, reduction, transfer and compression/output I/O. Preserve duplicate base/temporal volume work and count actual queries.
One complete raw final-query/output pilot pass is consistent with the plan. Do not calculate reference-versus-neural error, mass/parity/region quality or use raw outputs for selection.

Record process-lifetime RSS and unavailable current-memory/allocator/system-pressure telemetry explicitly; no capacity inference from absent probes. Save actual output bytes and temporary/archive observations.

Project using measured complete-step mean/median/observed maximum plus recurring fixed work; avoid summing overlapping timers or scaling one-time startup 10000 times. Keep 1200s decision scope explicit before full release.

prior_planar_receipts.use_limit: Historical category/completeness evidence only. Different operators, schedules, fields/compression and host conditions prohibit exact genuine2D runtime extrapolation or a 1200s guarantee.

execution_notes: Initial builtin-only text/arithmetic script used system Python3.9, which lacks datetime.UTC; it failed before creating a file. Corrected using existing Python3.12 environment; no scientific dependency or model was imported.
